description:
Outcome: A gardener sees their own allocated plot and season dates, from brief.md / First version must 3.
Scope: Personal allocated, waitlisted and unallocated status, season dates and accessible phone presentation. Excludes: coordinator plot map, public contact details and other households' allocations.
Acceptance: Display correct personal state and dates; household isolation is enforced server-side; updates reflect persisted allocations and waiting status.
Behaviour: Large text, plain language, keyboard access and clear empty/loading/error/retry states; no color-only status.
Verification: State, date, privacy and phone journey tests. Prerequisites: T-006, T-007 and T-004. Assumptions: none.
title: Gardener allocation view
